mission_06: FPGA-based AI accelerators offer customizable, energy-efficient inference by mapping neural network operations directly to hardware resources. DSP (Digital Signal Processing) blocks perform multiply-accumulate operations in fixed-point arithmetic, block RAM stores weights and activations, and configurable logic implements control flow. FPGAs achieve better energy efficiency than GPUs for specific workloads because they can be tailored to the exact computation pattern, eliminating unnecessary hardware. Fixed-point quantization reduces precision from 32-bit floats to 18-bit or fewer, trading accuracy for speed and power savings. In this mission, you implement fixed-point quantization, 2D convolution using DSP block parallelism, throughput estimation based on DSP count and clock frequency, power consumption modeling, and energy efficiency calculation in GOPS/Watt.
